name: Ripple tank & prism optics
doc: GPU 2D wave-tank and optical refraction simulation driven by the picked media: luma sets wave speed and lens depth, edges act as reflective coastlines and prism ridges, onsets drop pebbles that refract the picture with glowing caustics, highs split the light through chromatic prisms, and the picture momentarily re-forms at phrase turns.

in.doc: source media image or video refracted by waves and prisms

luma.doc: media brightness (e.g. core-media.luma) setting water depth and lens thickness

edges.doc: media edge gradient (e.g. core-media.edges) acting as reflective coastlines and prism facets

palette.doc: accent palette for caustic highlights, specular glints and thin-film iridescence

mode.doc: optical simulation regime: ripple-tank caustics, chromatic prism lenses, or standing-wave thin-film interferometer

cells.doc: wave tank grid height in cells (width follows aspect)

speed.doc: wave propagation speed across the tank

damp.doc: wave damping (lower keeps ripples ringing longer)

pebble.doc: strength of pebble drops spawned by onsets and beats

swell.doc: bass-driven standing tank swell and rhythmic wave forcing

edge_wall.doc: how strongly media edges reflect waves and emit contour ripples

refract.doc: optical refraction bend of the picture through wave slopes and lenses

caustic.doc: brightness of focused caustic light webs and specular glints

dispersion.doc: spectral RGB / 7-band chromatic prism splitting driven by highs

facets.doc: crystal prism / liquid lens facet density in prism mode

reform.doc: how cleanly the picture settles and re-forms at phrase boundaries

pal_mix.doc: palette colour accent in caustics, bevels and thin-film glints

changelog.note: first version: GPU 2D wave-tank caustic refraction, chromatic prism lenses, and thin-film interferometer driven by media and audio
